results.name: S1. Full copy: packages, drawings (JPEG + PDF, shared once), tombstone with recycle-bin copy, settings, orphan recovery, Mobile photo link; verified
S2. Rerun: nothing new; no media uploaded again; still verified
S3. Slice 1 plain job file is upgraded once to a package (next version)
S4. Interrupted run (after media and files): failed, no marker; rerun reuses media and files, nothing duplicated
S5. Tampered media file: verification fails, no marker
S6. A Production photo link is never fetched: run incomplete, no marker, everything else copied
S6b. Copied, not verified: a changed job with a Production link is written as the next version, its photo stays pending, Production is never fetched, no new marker, checkVerified false
S7. Settings: a change becomes the next version; a stale settings version stops the run
S8. Deleted jobs: copied job deleted later -> tombstone; purged bin copy -> tombstone with no copy; a tombstone is never written again
S9. Restore: with a recorded restore -> deliberate cloud restore; without -> conflict, never overwritten
S10. Orphan drawings are never dropped from the recovery list
S11. The marker covers everything: a changed drawing, setting, deleted list or history no longer counts as verified
S12. Scale: 40 jobs, 80 drawings (100 KB), 200 Mobile photo links, verified
